title: Plain text rows
detail: 3 full rows + part of the next. Most room for album and artist names.

title: Rows with a cover
detail: 3 full rows. Album and artist stay together; artwork reduces text width.

title: Compact paired rows
detail: 6 full albums in two columns. Both labels, with frequent truncation.

title: Covers with captions
detail: 4 full albums + another artwork row. Title and artist below each cover.

title: Inset cover cards
detail: 4 full cards + part of the next row. Small covers, short title and artist labels.

title: Full-image cards
detail: 4 full cards + part of the next row. Larger artwork behind short labels.

title: Covers only
detail: 8 full covers. No album or artist labels; depends on recognizing the artwork.

title: Round covers + titles
detail: 8 full albums. Title only; circular crops remove artwork corners.

title: Square covers + titles
detail: 8 full albums. Title only, with small covers and frequent truncation.
